patterns.statement: Persistent shop-economy island: huge totalRounds, ForceKeep items on death, fast respawn, regen off.
patterns.condition: Persistent-progression RPG island with no round structure
patterns.action: Set Experience Settings to a very high round count, keep items on death, 1 s respawn and no health recharge so the shop economy is the only progression

patterns.statement: Verse devices that wire through @editable references show no event bindings; read their settings instead of bindings to map the level.
patterns.condition: A Verse device needs other devices (buttons, triggers, spawners)
patterns.action: Expose them as @editable references and read their wiring via GetDeviceProperties, since ListEventBindings stays empty

patterns.statement: Mark bonus damage to avoid loops
patterns.condition: Bonus damage applied from a damage event
patterns.action: Apply extra damage with a custom causer and ignore that causer in the handler; guard against health and shield events both firing for one hit.

patterns.statement: A conditional button is the gold check
patterns.condition: Paying for a shop item with a currency item
patterns.action: Use a conditional button as the currency check: set required count to the price, activate for the player, then reset to 1.

patterns.statement: Save the shop on every purchase
patterns.condition: Selling permanent upgrades for in-match currency
patterns.action: Keep upgrades per player in a persistable record saved on every purchase, restored on spawn, with field defaults covering older saves.

patterns.statement: Cooldown and spread on group teleport
patterns.condition: Teleporting the group to one player
patterns.action: Add a cooldown and a spread cap, alternating sides, so repeated triggers and crowds do not stack players.

patterns.statement: Verse cannot reference third-party blueprint devices
patterns.condition: Verse logic must react to third-party blueprint devices (spawned enemies, collection characters)
patterns.action: Check first that Verse can reference the device class; if it cannot, hook the effect on the player side (damage events) or drop the feature instead of planning around the device.

patterns.statement: Register late joiners and re-attach handlers per respawn
patterns.condition: Per-player systems on a map where players join late and respawn
patterns.action: Register every joining player in the same routine used at start, and re-subscribe damage and shield handlers on each new character after a respawn.

patterns.statement: Escalating upgrade price, saved at once
patterns.condition: Permanent per-player upgrades bought with gold
patterns.action: Price each purchase as base plus base times purchase count times a scaler, save the player's data immediately after every purchase, and recompute final stats from base plus upgrades.

patterns.statement: Organise devices in folders, remove template leftovers
patterns.condition: A map with many placed devices
patterns.action: Group devices into Outliner folders by function and delete unused template maps before publishing, so the level stays readable and small.

patterns.statement: Group teleporter with cooldown and spread cap
patterns.condition: Keeping a group together in an arena
patterns.action: Use a trigger-driven group teleporter with a cooldown (about 10 s) and a spread distance cap (about 500 cm), placing others alternately beside the trigger player.

patterns.statement: Clear the per-hit busy flag one tick later
patterns.condition: A damage-on-hit handler applies extra damage to the target
patterns.action: Set a per-attacker busy flag when the hit is handled, clear it with Sleep(0.0) in a spawned task, so the bonus hit is not processed again as a new hit and the next real hit is not dropped.

patterns.statement: Empty UI slots are hidden, not given a stand-in icon
patterns.condition: A paged shop or list UI has slots that can be empty
patterns.action: Hide the slot's widgets and skip setting its image when the slot is empty; do not map the empty case to a real item icon, or a visibility change later shows the wrong picture.
